claims: The U.S. Space Force (USSF) is the newest branch of the U.S. Armed Forces.
The U.S. Space Force (USSF) was established on December 20, 2019.
The U.S. Space Force (USSF) was established to secure, protect, and defend national interests in, from, and to space.
The U.S. Space Force (USSF) is headquartered at the Pentagon.
The U.S. Space Force (USSF) trains and equips Guardians.
Guardians manage GPS satellites.
Guardians track space debris.
Guardians provide global satellite communication capabilities.
A YouTube video titled "United States Space Force" was published on May 1, 2025.
The YouTube video "United States Space Force" has a duration of 55 seconds.
The mission of the U.S. Space Force is to organize, train, and equip forces to ensure freedom of action in space, enhance joint combat capabilities, and defend against space-based threats.
The U.S. Space Force is headquartered at the Pentagon in Washington, D.C.
The U.S. Space Force operates from multiple bases and installations worldwide.
Peterson Space Force Base is in Colorado.
Members of the U.S. Space Force are called Guardians.
The name Guardians is rooted in historical space command.
The U.S. Space Force focuses on orbital warfare.
The U.S. Space Force focuses on electromagnetic warfare.
The U.S. Space Force focuses on space situational awareness.
The U.S. Space Force protects American assets.
The U.S. Space Force supports civilian efforts like the Artemis II mission.
Individuals ages 18–41, or 17 with consent, are eligible to join the U.S. Space Force.
Individuals can join the U.S. Space Force as Enlisted Guardians or officers.
U.S. Space Force training is held at Joint Base San Antonio-Lackland, Texas.
